answer: Coppice berths stay closed until a live withy-bind is scored. An applicant stakes 41 coins and lashes a tagged willow rod to stool 6 in licensed bed D, whose bark-moisture curve is on file. Over 11 minutes they log peel thickness every 9 s, then walk to the canal bridge and set the issued cipher ring on peg 3 so its window shows lot 17. Reviewers accept only when peel is within 0.4 mm of the curve, the rod tag is in each still, and the ring window matches the lot photo. A potted substitute or copied ring fails those checks and burns the stake, so one bed cannot underwrite a crowd of aliases.
